referenceValidationPolicy.scope: All task REST reference responses; preserve supplied CSV keys and aliases. Direct-user-input fields remain exempt.

procedure: Preserve the unchanged customer request outside the business blueprint.
Use the selected task skill and compiled ora_rule_registry.json to resolve task semantics and blockers.

For root creates, normalize fills omitted fields with the task UI create defaults, including Review proposed payments Y and both rejection levels Stop process for review. Preserve explicit values and blanks, disclose all defaults, and apply proven payment-mode effects. Never default updates or use existing template rows as create defaults.
Write only explicit operations, target keys, requested values, resolved scope, defaults, prerequisites, preservation assertions, and warnings into the normalized design input.

For supported mapped fields, apply known local checks and declared REST or direct-input policies, then use normal Data Loader preview and approval with Fusion as the application validator. Do not require proof of internal setter order, helper revision or future persistence. Selection-key mutation and missing CSV mappings remain outside the supported operation contract.

Apply every known deterministic validation first; when an update field remains explicitly evidence-unresolved, disclose the gap and offer the implementor the exact governed application-validation override without relabeling the field as supported.

For a supplied SupplierType, use the listed labels first. An unlisted name needs the declared resolve_supplier_type_rest read through Core REST and a field/operation/value-bound receipt in prerequisites; one or more exact Meaning matches pass. Do not infer invalid input from an API/auth failure, substitute a code or silently defer the missing secondary check to import.
Run the normalize command to validate the design and emit the portable blueprint, complete preview, and stable requirements list.
